title: Spicy Venezuelan Quesadilla Filling
description: A flavorful and spicy filling for vegan quesadillas, inspired by Venezuelan cuisine.
instructions: 1. Roast the peppers in the oven at 400°F (200°C) for 30 minutes.
2. Cook the black beans in a pan over medium heat with smoked paprika.
3. Combine the roasted peppers, black beans, and vegan cheese in a bowl.
4. Squeeze lime juice over the mixture and stir to combine.
6. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
7. Place a tortilla in the pan and spoon the filling onto half of the tortilla.
8. Fold the tortilla in half and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the tortilla is crispy.
9. Flip the quesadilla and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until crispy and golden.
